passives.name: GriffithFemtoEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
This unit has $GriffithFemtoMeter, starting at 0. (Capacity: {1})

If an enemy survives $Distortion's damage:
- Inflict enemy with $GriffithFemtoMark for {6} seconds
- Gain {2} $GriffithFemtoMeter

For every enemy in range with $GriffithFemtoMark:
- Increase this unit's damage by {4}%
- Increase this unit's range by {5}%

$GriffithFemtoMark cannot stack.
Enemies inflicted with $GriffithFemtoMark will take {3}% increased damage from this unit.
